items.prompt:
A print article is especially good at emphasizing:
A) data and detail
B) a speaker's tone
C) background music

A video account can especially emphasize:
A) emotional/human impact
B) a word's spelling
C) footnotes

An audio report emphasizes a speaker's:
A) tone and voice
B) exact lighting
C) page count

A print article on a flood gives statistics; a video shows families being rescued. The video emphasizes:
A) the human/emotional impact
B) the statistics
C) the page count

steps: Video = human drama. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why analyze MULTIPLE accounts of the same event?
A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture
B) to pick the shortest
C) to ignore the event
items.answer: A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture

solution.answer: A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture

items.prompt:
A radio report conveys a speaker's TONE that a transcript cannot. This shows audio emphasizes:
A) vocal delivery and tone
B) exact statistics
C) visual detail

Three accounts cover a protest: an article lists the crowd size, a photo captures one tearful face, and a video shows the chanting march. Together they:
A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone
B) must all be false
C) are identical
items.answer: A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone

steps: Combined emphasis = fuller picture. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone

items.prompt:
When analyzing accounts in different mediums, the KEY question is:
A) which details each account emphasizes and why
B) which is cheapest
C) which is oldest
items.answer: A) which details each account emphasizes and why

solution.answer: A) which details each account emphasizes and why
